titulo.alumno:
«Повторение и единичный результат»
Repetition and a single action

intro: The imperfective usually expresses habits and repetitions; the perfective, a specific fact with a limit.

piezas.titulo: The imperfective usually expresses habits and repetitions; the perfective, a specific fact with a limit.
texto: The imperfective usually expresses habits and repetitions; the perfective, a specific fact with a limit.
Time expressions help, but they do not decide the aspect alone: also consider what the verb is meant to communicate.

frases.alumno: In the evenings he used to watch the news.
Yesterday he watched the new episode.

opciones.explicacion: A repeated habit is normally expressed with the imperfective.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «По вечерам он смотрел новости.»

opciones.texto: In the evenings he used to watch the news.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: Yesterday he watched the new episode.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

piezas.traduccion: Yesterday he watched the new episode.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
